Operating from a 100-acre mining campus in Murugantholuvu, Chennimalai, home to 10 million tons of premium blue metal reserves, we supply M Sand, P Sand, Blue Metal aggregates, K Blocks solid blocks, Ready Mix Concrete and Tile Fix Pro tile adhesive.

Our 150 TPH 4-stage sand manufacturing plant produces sand that meets IS standards. As the nearest blue metal quarry to Erode, we deliver within two hours across Chennimalai, Perundurai, Erode, Tiruppur and Namakkal districts.
